steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Food choice is influenced by multiple interacting factors: social, economic, cultural, religious, ethical, psychological, and health-related. | Key Fact: Social factors include: family meals and traditions, peer pressure, media and advertising, and social status (e.g. eating out as a social activity). | Key Fact: Economic factors include: income level, food prices, availability of affordable fresh produce, and access to shops (food deserts). | Key Fact: Cultural factors: different cultures have distinct food traditions, staple foods, flavour preferences, and cooking methods (e.g. rice in Asian cuisine, pasta in Italian cuisine).
